fields.name: displayInstructions3
fields.fieldText:
How to Create a New Contact

  • Contact data received through the intake form is automatically loaded below.
  • Review the information for accuracy.
  • Use the Search Google Maps to verify and standardize addresses
  • Click Back if you need to return to the previous screen.
  • Click Create Contact to save the new contact record and link the intake record.

fields.name: displayInstructions2
fields.fieldText:
How to Review Records for Field Updates

  • The table below displays contact data that exists on the selected contact record and current intake record. Review the data below and select the value you wish to save to the contact record.
  • By default, Salesforce will not overwrite an existing value on the contact record with a blank value from the intake record. If you wish to erase a field value on the contact record, you must perform this manually.
  • Additionally, Salesforce will automatically overwrite blank contact fields with non-blank intake data.
  • If the contact and intake records have the same value for a field, no action is required.
  • If the contact and intake records have different values for a field, indicate which data to use:
    • Selecting Contact will use the value in the middle column, under Contact Fields.
    • Selecting Intake will use the value in the right column, under Intake Fields.
  • Click Back if you need to return to the previous screen.
  • Once you have made selections for all fields available, click Finish. Salesforce will automatically update the contact record and link it to the intake.

fields.name: displayInstructions
fields.fieldText:
How to Match & Link Intakes to Contacts

  • Salesforce automatically runs a background contact search based on data entered into this intake record. Salesforce searches for contacts according to the following order of operations:
    • Match on any email address
    • Match on any phone number
    • Match on exact last name and fuzzy first name
  • Matched contacts are presented in the table below
  • Select a matched contact from the table if you are confident that the contact record corresponds to the current intake. Salesforce will automatically link the selected contact to the intake record
  • If there are no matched contacts, check Create New Contact. Salesforce will automatically create a new contact record using data from the intake and link the two records
  • Click Next
